description: This file implements a ThunderJS client library for WebSocket communication, including connection management, request handling, event subscription, and plugin registration.

classes.name: DeviceInfo
classes.description: Provides methods to retrieve system information such as free RAM and version.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection based on provided options.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC request over WebSocket.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers an event listener for plugin events.

methods.name: once
methods.description: Registers a one-time event listener for plugin events.

methods.name: registerPlugin
methods.description: Registers a new plugin with the ThunderJS instance.
